jizang.oneLineZh: 隋唐三论宗大师，以中观二谛与破邪显正组织教判论辩。
jizang.oneLineEn: Sui-Tang Sanlun master organizing doctrinal debate via Madhyamaka two truths and refuting error.

li-ao.oneLineZh: 唐代儒者，以《复性书》讨论性情结构与恢复本性之路。
li-ao.oneLineEn: Tang Confucian who, in Fuxing shu, discusses nature-emotion structure and restoring original nature.

shao-yong.oneLineZh: 北宋理学先驱，以象数宇宙论和观物思想重写秩序生成。
shao-yong.oneLineEn: Image-number cosmology pioneer of the Song who rewrites order through observing things.

zhang-shi.oneLineZh: 南宋湖湘学派人物，与朱熹长期论学并主张敬义并进路径。
zhang-shi.oneLineEn: Huxiang school figure who debated Zhu Xi at length and joined reverence with rightness.

chen-xianzhang.oneLineZh: 明代白沙学派创始人，强调心体自得与静坐涵养之工夫。
chen-xianzhang.oneLineEn: Founder of Ming Baisha school, stressing mind's self-attainment and quiet-sitting cultivation.

hu-hong.oneLineZh: 南宋湖湘学派人物，以《知言》讨论性体与修养具体路径。
hu-hong.oneLineEn: Huxiang school figure who, in Zhiyan, discusses nature's substance and concrete cultivation paths.

huan-tan.oneLineZh: 两汉之际思想家，以《新论》坚持反谶纬的理性批判立场。
huan-tan.oneLineEn: Han-transition thinker who, in Xinlun, holds a rational critical stance against prophetic weft texts.

kou-qianzhi.oneLineZh: 北魏道教改革者，推动新天师道与国家政治的制度结合。
kou-qianzhi.oneLineEn: Northern Wei Daoist reformer joining New Celestial Masters practice to state political institutions.

luo-congyan.oneLineZh: 宋代理学人物，承接程门并影响李侗朱熹一系闽学脉络。
luo-congyan.oneLineEn: Song Neo-Confucian transmitting Cheng school and shaping the Li Tong–Zhu Xi Fujian lineage.

sima-tan.oneLineZh: 西汉太史令，以六家分类为《史记》思想框架提供前史。
sima-tan.oneLineEn: Western Han Grand Astrologer whose six-schools taxonomy framed later thought in the Shiji project.

wu-qi.oneLineZh: 战国军事家与改革者，兼具兵家战法与法家制度变革色彩。
wu-qi.oneLineEn: Warring States commander-reformer combining military methods with Legalist institutional change.

wu-yubi.oneLineZh: 明初理学家，以康斋学派居敬实践影响陈献章一路学风。
wu-yubi.oneLineEn: Early Ming Neo-Confucian whose Kangzhai reverence practice shaped Chen Xianzhang's scholarly path.

yan-ying.oneLineZh: 春秋齐国政治家，以节俭、机智谏诤见载于《晏子春秋》。
yan-ying.oneLineEn: Spring-Autumn Qi statesman of thrift and witty remonstrance, preserved in Yanzi chunqiu.

cui-shu.oneLineZh: 清代考据学者，以《考信录》系统辨析上古史传可信度。
cui-shu.oneLineEn: Qing evidential scholar who, in Kaoxin lu, systematically tests high-antiquity narrative credibility.

daosheng.oneLineZh: 东晋刘宋僧人，倡顿悟成佛并卷入一阐提能否成佛争论。
daosheng.oneLineEn: Eastern Jin–Liu Song monk advocating sudden enlightenment and the icchantika-buddhahood debate.

daoxuan.oneLineZh: 唐代律宗大师与佛教史家，兼定律学规范并编僧传文献。
daoxuan.oneLineEn: Tang Vinaya master and Buddhist historian codifying discipline and compiling monk biographies.

ge-hong.oneLineZh: 东晋道教思想家，以《抱朴子》系统整理炼养与神仙理论。
ge-hong.oneLineEn: Eastern Jin Daoist who, in Baopuzi, systematically organizes nourishing life and immortality theory.

kuiji.oneLineZh: 唐代法相宗大师，玄奘弟子，建成唯识注疏的慈恩体系。
kuiji.oneLineEn: Tang Faxiang master, Xuanzang's disciple, building the Ci'en system of Yogācāra commentaries.

li-gong-qing.oneLineZh: 清初颜李学派人物，继承颜元实学传统与实践教育路线。
li-gong-qing.oneLineEn: Early Qing Yan-Li figure continuing Yan Yuan's practical learning and practice-based education.

li-zhi.oneLineZh: 晚明思想家，以童心说与反伪道学强调个体真诚的表达。
li-zhi.oneLineEn: Late Ming thinker stressing childlike mind, anti-pseudo-Dao learning, and sincere individual expression.

sima-qian.oneLineZh: 西汉史学家，《史记》作者，确立纪传体通史书写典范。
sima-qian.oneLineEn: Western Han historian, author of the Shiji, establishing biographical comprehensive-history writing.

tang-zhen.oneLineZh: 清初思想家，以《潜书》尖锐批判君主权力与社会不平。
tang-zhen.oneLineEn: Early Qing thinker who, in Qianshu, sharply criticizes monarchical power and social injustice.

xiang-xiu.oneLineZh: 魏晋玄学人物，以《庄子注》讨论自然与名教之间的关系。
xiang-xiu.oneLineEn: Wei-Jin xuanxue figure using Zhuangzi commentary to discuss nature and the teaching of names.

xuanzang.oneLineZh: 唐代高僧与译经家，以西行求法与主持译场夯实法相唯识学基础。
xuanzang.oneLineEn: Tang monk-translator whose western journey and translation bureau secured Faxiang Yogācāra foundations.

xue-xuan.oneLineZh: 明代理学家，河东学派人物，强调复性工夫与笃实践履。
xue-xuan.oneLineEn: Ming Hedong Neo-Confucian stressing work of restoring nature and earnest embodied practice.

xun-yue.oneLineZh: 东汉末史学家与政论家，以《申鉴》《汉纪》讨论治道。
xun-yue.oneLineEn: Late Eastern Han historian-essayist treating the way of governance in Shenjian and Hanji.

yin-wen.oneLineZh: 战国稷下人物，与名实、刑名及尹文子一系传统紧密相连。
yin-wen.oneLineEn: Jixia figure closely tied to name-reality, xingming, and the Yin Wenzi line of tradition.

zhang-xuecheng.oneLineZh: 清代史学理论家，以六经皆史与文史校雠重定史学方法。
zhang-xuecheng.oneLineEn: Qing historical theorist recasting method via six classics as history and literary collation.

zheng-xuan.oneLineZh: 东汉经学大师，综合今古文并建成郑笺一系之注疏体系。
zheng-xuan.oneLineEn: Eastern Han classics master synthesizing New/Old Text learning into the Zheng commentary system.

fan-zhen.oneLineZh: 南朝思想家，以《神灭论》批判神不灭说与因果报应观。
fan-zhen.oneLineEn: Southern Dynasties thinker who, in Shenmie lun, attacks immortal soul and karmic retribution views.

he-yan.oneLineZh: 曹魏玄学人物，主持《论语集解》并推动贵无论的讨论。
he-yan.oneLineEn: Cao-Wei xuanxue figure editing Lunyu jijie and advancing discussions of valuing non-being.

hu-yuan.oneLineZh: 北宋教育家，以安定学派经义治事之法重定书院教育秩序。
hu-yuan.oneLineEn: Anding-school educator reshaping academies via classics-and-affairs training methods.

li-gou.oneLineZh: 北宋儒者与制度思想家，长于礼制、财政与经世制度改革。
li-gou.oneLineEn: Institutional thinker of the Song skilled in ritual order, finance, and statecraft reform.

liu-zongzhou.oneLineZh: 明末大儒，蕺山学派创始人，以慎独与诚意确立工夫论。
liu-zongzhou.oneLineEn: Late Ming master founding the Jishan school on vigilance in solitude and sincere intention.

lu-longqi.oneLineZh: 清初程朱学者与循吏，以尊朱讲学并重视地方治理实践。
lu-longqi.oneLineEn: Early Qing Cheng-Zhu scholar-official joining Zhu Xi teaching to local governance practice.

mao-qiling.oneLineZh: 清初经学家，以博辨考据批评朱子对《四书》之解释路径。
mao-qiling.oneLineEn: Early Qing classicist using broad evidential argument to criticize Zhu Xi on the Four Books.

song-xing.oneLineZh: 战国稷下思想人物，常与尹文并称，主张节欲与非斗路径。
song-xing.oneLineEn: Jixia thinker often paired with Yin Wen, urging restraint of desire and non-fighting.

ye-shi.oneLineZh: 南宋永嘉学派人物，以制度、功利与学术史批评见称于世。
ye-shi.oneLineEn: Yongjia school figure known for institutional, utilitarian, and intellectual-history critique.
